name: Ghost Cache
description: The Null Choir, a hacker collective, vanished from the relay after a routine midnight sync. Their file share is still answering on the lab network, but its exposed assets may not all be what they seem. Recover the flag from the genuine collective archive. Explore the challenge hosts and cross-reference what the share exposes with other evidence on the system. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
